issues.title: Trial genomic breeding value mean does not match the materials observed in the trial
issues.root_cause: the trial summary is not derived from the observed materials: correlation between reported and recomputed values is -0.20 (1.0 if one were computed from the other); the summary was probably generated from a different material set or independently
issues.fix: derived column GBV_MEAN_RECOMPUTED added next to the original; the rules keep the reported value because the official verdicts were computed on it
issues.impact: see what_if_recomputed_aggregates in the quality report
issues.sme_question: Which material set is the trial-level genomic breeding value mean computed from?

issues.title: Trial resistant-material share does not match the materials observed in the trial
issues.root_cause: the trial summary is not derived from the observed materials: correlation between reported and recomputed values is -0.13 (1.0 if one were computed from the other); the summary was probably generated from a different material set or independently
issues.fix: derived column RESISTANT_PCT_RECOMPUTED added next to the original; the rules keep the reported value because the official verdicts were computed on it
issues.impact: see what_if_recomputed_aggregates in the quality report
issues.sme_question: Which material set is the trial-level resistant-material share computed from?

issues.title: Field operations reference a material that was not observed in that trial
issues.root_cause: wrong trial key on the operation: in 131/131 cases the material IS observed at the same location, in another trial of the same season, i.e. the operation was booked against a sibling trial
issues.fix: quarantined: excluded from every trial-level computation; a unique reassignment is proposed when only one sibling trial contains the material (none is unique here: each material appears in 4-5 sibling trials, so a human must decide)
issues.impact: no effect on verdicts (operations do not enter the rules); planting dates use linked operations only
issues.sme_question: Are operations recorded per trial or per location/season block?

issues.title: Operation dates fall in a different year than their trial
issues.root_cause: every operation is dated within 2026-04-01 .. 2026-09-26 whatever the trial year: the dates look like export/generation timestamps rather than field dates
issues.fix: dates flagged YEAR_OK=False; they are not used for seasonality features
issues.impact: planting-date seasonality removed from the calibrated model (see excluded_features)
issues.sme_question: Is OPERATION_DATE the field date or the record's creation date?

issues.title: Harvest or irrigation dated before planting
issues.root_cause: planting-to-harvest offsets are not physically consistent (median 0 d, std 52 d, min -28 d): the dates are not usable as a timeline
issues.fix: flagged; not imputed (the offset dispersion is too large for any defensible imputation)
issues.impact: no timeline features are derived from operations
